# Launch Screen Assets

`LaunchImage` is the Cupola mark at 112 pt, generated by the icon pipeline (`scripts/generate_icons.sh --write`, the
`launch` targets in `scripts/icons/export.py`); never edit these files by hand. `LaunchScreen.storyboard` centres it on
`LaunchGround`, the room's ground in each appearance (`color.room.ground` in `design/tokens/theme/`), which
`test/core/identity/signature_guard_test.dart` holds against the tokens.
